Called '''Garools''' in [[Ergesh language]], or '''muckworms''' in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], were parasitic sanguivores from [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]]. They sucked fluid out of their victim until death. The muckworms were deadly enemies of the [[Ergesh]], on the other hand, the Ergesh considered Garool a great delicacy.
